statement: The recorded dose is **not safe or correct** for this 6.0 kg, 5-month-old infant: 480 mg is 80 mg/kg, far above the usual 10–15 mg/kg dose, so I will not administer it; please urgently verify the order with the prescriber/pharmacist.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "480 mg is 80 mg/kg, far above the usual 10–15 mg/kg dose," asserting the dose is unsafe and refusing to give it.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
